topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Discovering the novel was like unearthing a time capsule of our lives, except it was a version I didn’t recognize. Each page turned, and the words seemed to form a shadow, a dim outline of the moments we shared, twisted into something darker, more complex. It’s strange, isn’t it, to find yourself a character in someone else’s story, a narrative you never agreed to enter? The room felt smaller, the air thicker, as I read on. I wondered how much of it was real, how much was a fabrication, and whether the person who wrote it still saw me the same way they did when they started.
